strategy: Open the delta exam study guide on a second screen
Have release notes open in another tab
Use Ctrl+F to search for keywords from questions
Multi-select questions: first answer is usually easy, second requires digging
If not in study guide, check docs.servicenow.com
commonMistakes: Not having the study guide open during the exam
Trying to memorize instead of using Ctrl+F
Not checking the release notes when study guide doesn't have the answer
